description: This Java source file defines the class MidiInputPortSelector, which manages a user interface component (Spinner) for selecting and handling MIDI input ports on Android devices. It handles opening MIDI devices, obtaining input ports, and cleanly closing resources.

classes.name: MidiInputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that extends MidiPortSelector, specifically managing MIDI input ports via a user interface Spinner, allowing users to select and connect to MIDI input ports on Android devices.

methods.name: MidiInputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with necessary MIDI manager, activity context, and UI spinner ID.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a MIDI port, opens the device and input port asynchronously.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver associated with the selected input port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the MIDI input port and device, releasing resources.
